theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' A ⊆ R.carrier → ∫⁻ x in G '' A, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → (∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict A), ∃ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) * R.orient (G a) β = σ * β (fun k => fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) → Differentiable ℝ φ → LipschitzWith Λ φ → (((∃ κ' : ℝ, 0 < κ' ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, κ' * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖φ (G a) - φ (G a')‖) ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ G) a)) ∨ ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ G) a)) → ∃ (N : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℤ) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet N ∧ N ⊆ φ '' (G '' A) ∧ CountablyRectifiable n N ∧ Measurable g ∧ (∀ y ∈ N, g y ≠ 0) ∧ StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y T ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η y) T) ∧ ∫⁻ y in N, ((g y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ∫⁻ x in G '' A, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∀ β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, StronglyMeasurable β → ∫ x in G '' A, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((β (φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ φ x)) ∂μHE[n] = ∫ y in N, (g y : ℝ) * η y (β y) ∂μHE[n]
